mentions.name: Tab stack browser extension
mentions.description: This browser extension treats tabs as a stack, letting users open tabs down a rabbit hole and then use a keyboard shortcut to close the current tab and jump back to its parent tab.
mentions.problem: Standard tab handling makes it cumbersome to unwind a chain of tabs opened while going down a rabbit hole, since closing a tab does not return you to its parent tab.
mentions.source_excerpt: An extension which treats tabs as a stack - so I can go down a rabbit hole opening new tabs and then use a shortcut to close a tab and take me to the parent of that tab

evidence.value: An extension which treats tabs as a stack - so I can go down a rabbit hole opening new tabs and then use a shortcut to close a tab and take me to the parent of that tab
